# YouGlass 1.0.3
This patch makes opening a video feel more immediate and stable.
## Highlights
- Re-keyed the native player surface for each selected video so the previous video's WebKit frame cannot flash into the new player. - Ignored late playback callbacks from an earlier video during fast navigation. - Reserved the final watch layout before the media surface mounts, reducing the visible resize jump on first load. - Limited the connection fade to the media pixels so the player frame, controls, and surrounding details stay fixed. - Kept responsive sizing intact across compact MacBook displays, Mac mini setups, and larger screens.
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon only. - macOS 14 or later. - No account, playback, or YouTube API permissions change is required.

# YouGlass 1.0.2
This maintenance patch makes the updater easier to find and use.
## Highlights
- Added **Check for Updates...** to the native YouGlass application menu. - Placed the command directly below About and above Settings, following standard macOS menu placement. - Kept Sparkle’s signed GitHub update flow unchanged.
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon only. - macOS 14 or later.

# YouGlass 1.0.1
This patch adds a more tactile way to browse video artwork in YouGlass.
## Highlights
- Added a pointer-reactive parallax hover effect to home feed thumbnails, compact recommendations, channel videos, and Up Next items. - Added a restrained liquid-glass lift with gentle tilt, image drift, and spring-back motion. - Kept thumbnail motion inside each artwork frame so hovering does not reflow or resize surrounding cards. - Improved hover hit testing across the full thumbnail surface.
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon only. - macOS 14 or later. - No account, playback, or YouTube API behavior changed in this patch.
